title: NH teen allegedly caused crash at airport while driving under the influence, police say
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Crime The suspect allegedly drove his car through a fence and across an aircraft parking apron before crashing into a tractor and an aircraft.

By Darin Zullo August 30, 2026 | 10:19 AM 1 minute to read A New Hampshire teen is facing criminal charges after allegedly driving while under the influence and causing a crash at Portsmouth International Airport on Saturday, police said.

Wyatt Seely, 17, of Rochester, New Hampshire, was charged with aggravated driving while intoxicated, driving while intoxicated, disobeying a police officer, conduct after an accident, and reckless driving, New Hampshire State Police said in a press release.
